description: This Java class configures Spring Security settings, specifically setting up a security filter chain that enables CORS, disables CSRF, and permits public access to specific endpoints like documentation, health checks, and the root URL.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up security filter chains for enabling CORS and defining access rules for various endpoints.

methods.name: apiFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, configuring CORS, CSRF, and request authorization rules.
